title: Desk Rule Note — Refunds on Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Rule.** Every refund on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order goes back to the tender of the payment it refunds and references that payment line. A refund never exceeds the payment it references, and when a refund spans several payments the most recent payments are refunded first. Refunds are issued only on orders whose status is cancelled, returned or completed. A payment line is refunded at most once.

**Evidence.** The order status is the one on the special order record before the refund. Whether a payment line has already been refunded is shown by a refund line on the order that references that payment line.

## Status check

| Order status | Refund issued |
|---|---|
| cancelled, returned, completed | yes |
| placed, vendor confirmed, in production, shipped, ready | no |

## Worked refund (hypothetical cancelled order)

Payments on the order: a 250.00 deposit by bank card on 2 March and a 170.00 balance payment on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account on 20 April. Refund due: 300.00.

| Order of refunding | Payment line | Refunded | Tender refunded to |
|---|---|---|---|
| first — most recent | 170.00 of 20 April | 170.00 | Ridgeline Consumer Credit |
| second | 250.00 of 2 March | 130.00 | bank card |

Each payment line is referenced by one refund line; neither refund exceeds the payment it references, and neither payment line is refunded again.
